title: Affine mappings of translation surfaces: shrinking targets and Diophantine properties
summary: Let $(X,ω)$ be a translation surface whose Veech group $Γ_ω$ is a lattice. We prove that the generic orbit of the group of affine homeomorphisms of $(X,ω)$ can be used to approximate each point of $X$ with Diophantine precision. The proof utilizes an induced $SL_2(\mathbb{R})$-action on a fiber bundle $Y_ω$ whose base is $SL_2(\mathbb{R})/Γ_ω$ and whose fiber is a quotient of $X$.
